verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is LangSmith Engine, a built-in feature that automatically detects recurring trace issues, diagnoses root causes and resolves them. That amounts to delegating issue triage to an in-product automated agent, but the docs never describe it as a general AI assistant that accepts user-delegated tasks. Missing for 10: an explicit conversational or general-purpose AI assistant, documentation of which tasks users can delegate and how, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Automatically detect recurring issues in your traces, diagnose their root cause, and resolve them with LangSmith Engine.
